deadline.value: ESS application deadline is December 1; the page gives no year, so 2026 is inferred for Fall 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: The application deadline is 11:59 pm EST on December 1st.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL or IELTS is required unless the language of instruction was English; no minimum score is given.

ielts_min.value: IELTS is accepted in the same way as TOEFL; no minimum score is given.

english_waiver.value: If the degree's language of instruction is English, the TOEFL or IELTS is not required.
english_waiver.quote: If the student’s language of instruction is in English, the TOEFL or IELTS scores are not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants must show alignment with at least three faculty, but the page does not say contact or agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: The Laney Graduate School says it offers tuition scholarships and stipend support to most doctoral students.
funding.quote: The Laney Graduate School offers tuition scholarships and stipend support to most doctoral students.

entry_route.value: The ESS pages do not say whether a bachelor's alone is enough; no MS-only programme is offered.
